verses.original: Παῦλος δοῦλος Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ κλητὸς ἀπόστολος ἀφωρισμένος εἰς εὐαγγέλιον Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Paulos doulos Christou Iēsou klētos apostolos aphōrismenos eis euangelion Theou
verses.literal: Paul a servant of Christ Jesus called [to be] [an] apostle [and] set apart for [the] gospel of God

verses.original: ὃ προεπηγγείλατο διὰ αὐτοῦ τῶν προφητῶν ἐν ἁγίαις γραφαῖς
verses.transliteration: ho proepēngeilato dia autou tōn prophētōn en hagiais graphais
verses.literal: [the gospel] He promised beforehand through His - prophets in [the] Holy Scriptures

verses.original: περὶ αὐτοῦ τοῦ Υἱοῦ τοῦ γενομένου ἐκ σπέρματος Δαυὶδ κατὰ σάρκα
verses.transliteration: peri autou tou Huiou tou genomenou ek spermatos Dauid kata sarka
verses.literal: regarding His - Son who was a descendant . . . . . . of David according to [the] flesh

verses.original: τοῦ κατὰ πνεῦμα ἁγιωσύνης ὁρισθέντος ἐν δυνάμει Υἱοῦ Θεοῦ ἐξ ἀναστάσεως νεκρῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἡμῶν τοῦ Κυρίου
verses.transliteration: tou kata pneuma hagiōsynēs horisthentos en dynamei Huiou Theou ex anastaseōs nekrōn Iēsou Christou hēmōn tou Kyriou
verses.literal: [and] who through [the] Spirit of holiness was declared with power [to be the] Son of God by [His] resurrection [from the] dead Jesus Christ our - Lord

verses.original: δι’ οὗ ὑπὲρ αὐτοῦ τοῦ ὀνόματος ἐλάβομεν χάριν καὶ ἀποστολὴν εἰς πᾶσιν ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ὑπακοὴν πίστεως
verses.transliteration: di’ hou hyper autou tou onomatos elabomen charin kai apostolēn eis pasin en tois ethnesin hypakoēn pisteōs
verses.literal: Through [Him] [and] on behalf of His - name we received grace and apostleship to call all [those] among the Gentiles [to the] obedience that comes from faith

verses.original: ὑμεῖς καὶ ἐστε ἐν οἷς κλητοὶ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: hymeis kai este en hois klētoi Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: [And] you also are among those who are called [to belong to] Jesus Christ

verses.original: Πᾶσιν τοῖς οὖσιν ἐν Ῥώμῃ ἀγαπητοῖς Θεοῦ κλητοῖς ἁγίοις Χάρις καὶ εἰρήνη ὑμῖν ἀπὸ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν Πατρὸς καὶ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: Pasin tois ousin en Rhōmē agapētois Theou klētois hagiois Charis kai eirēnē hymin apo Theou hēmōn Patros kai Kyriou Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: To all - - in Rome who are loved by God [and] called to be saints Grace and peace to you from God our Father and [the] Lord Jesus Christ

verses.original: Πρῶτον μὲν εὐχαριστῶ μου τῷ Θεῷ διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ περὶ πάντων ὑμῶν ὅτι ὑμῶν ἡ πίστις καταγγέλλεται ὅλῳ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ
verses.transliteration: Prōton men eucharistō mou tō Theō dia Iēsou Christou peri pantōn hymōn hoti hymōn hē pistis katangelletai holō en tō kosmō
verses.literal: First - I thank my - God through Jesus Christ for all of you because your - faith is being proclaimed all over the world

verses.original: γάρ ὁ Θεός ᾧ λατρεύω ἐν μου τῷ πνεύματί ἐν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ τοῦ αὐτοῦ Υἱοῦ ἐστιν μού μάρτυς ὡς ἀδιαλείπτως ποιοῦμαι μνείαν ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: gar ho Theos hō latreuō en mou tō pneumati en tō euangeliō tou autou Huiou estin mou martys hōs adialeiptōs poioumai mneian hymōn
verses.literal: - - God whom I serve with my - spirit in {preaching} the gospel of His Son is my witness how constantly vvv I remember you

verses.original: ἐπὶ μου τῶν προσευχῶν πάντοτε δεόμενος εἴ πως ἤδη ποτὲ ἐν τῷ τοῦ Θεοῦ θελήματι εὐοδωθήσομαι ἐλθεῖν πρὸς ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: epi mou tōn proseuchōn pantote deomenos ei pōs ēdē pote en tō tou Theou thelēmati euodōthēsomai elthein pros hymas
verses.literal: in my - prayers at all times asking that . . . now at last by - - God’s will I may succeed in coming to you

verses.original: γὰρ ἐπιποθῶ ἰδεῖν ὑμᾶς ἵνα μεταδῶ ὑμῖν τι πνευματικὸν χάρισμα εἰς τὸ στηριχθῆναι ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: gar epipothō idein hymas hina metadō hymin ti pneumatikon charisma eis to stērichthēnai hymas
verses.literal: For I long to see you so that I may impart to you some spiritual gift to - strengthen you

verses.original: δέ τοῦτο ἐστιν τε ὑμῶν καὶ ἐμοῦ συμπαρακληθῆναι ἐν ὑμῖν διὰ ἐν ἀλλήλοις τῆς πίστεως
verses.transliteration: de touto estin te hymōn kai emou symparaklēthēnai en hymin dia en allēlois tēs pisteōs
verses.literal: - that is [that] you and I may be mutually encouraged . . . . . . by - each other’s - faith

verses.original: δὲ Οὐ θέλω ὑμᾶς ἀγνοεῖν ἀδελφοί ὅτι πολλάκις προεθέμην ἐλθεῖν πρὸς ὑμᾶς καὶ ἐκωλύθην ἄχρι τοῦ δεῦρο ἵνα σχῶ τινὰ καρπὸν ἐν ὑμῖν καὶ καὶ καθὼς ἐν τοῖς λοιποῖς ἔθνεσιν
verses.transliteration: de Ou thelō hymas agnoein adelphoi hoti pollakis proethemēn elthein pros hymas kai ekōlythēn achri tou deuro hina schō tina karpon en hymin kai kai kathōs en tois loipois ethnesin
verses.literal: - vvv I do not want you to be unaware brothers how often I planned to come to you ([but] have been prevented [from visiting] until vvv now) in order that I might have a harvest among you - just as [I have had] among the other Gentiles

verses.original: εἰμί ὀφειλέτης τε Ἕλλησίν καὶ Βαρβάροις τε σοφοῖς καὶ ἀνοήτοις
verses.transliteration: eimi opheiletēs te Hellēsin kai Barbarois te sophois kai anoētois
verses.literal: I am obligated both to Greeks and non-Greeks both to [the] wise and [the] foolish

verses.original: οὕτως τὸ κατ’ ἐμὲ πρόθυμον εὐαγγελίσασθαι καὶ ὑμῖν τοῖς ἐν Ῥώμῃ
verses.transliteration: houtōs to kat’ eme prothymon euangelisasthai kai hymin tois en Rhōmē
verses.literal: That is why - - I am [so] eager to preach the gospel also to you who [are] in Rome

verses.original: γὰρ Οὐ ἐπαισχύνομαι τὸ εὐαγγέλιον γὰρ ἐστιν δύναμις Θεοῦ εἰς σωτηρίαν παντὶ τῷ πιστεύοντι τε πρῶτον Ἰουδαίῳ καὶ Ἕλληνι
verses.transliteration: gar Ou epaischynomai to euangelion gar estin dynamis Theou eis sōtērian panti tō pisteuonti te prōton Ioudaiō kai Hellēni
verses.literal: - vvv I am not ashamed of the gospel because it is [the] power of God for salvation to everyone who believes - first to [the] Jew then to [the] Greek

verses.original: γὰρ ἐν αὐτῷ ἀποκαλύπτεται δικαιοσύνη Θεοῦ ἐκ πίστεως εἰς πίστιν καθὼς γέγραπται δὲ Ὁ δίκαιος ζήσεται ἐκ πίστεως
verses.transliteration: gar en autō apokalyptetai dikaiosynē Theou ek pisteōs eis pistin kathōs gegraptai de Ho dikaios zēsetai ek pisteōs
verses.literal: For - [the gospel] reveals [the] righteousness of God [that comes] by faith [from start] to [finish] just as it is written - The righteous will live by faith

verses.original: γὰρ ὀργὴ Θεοῦ Ἀποκαλύπτεται ἀπ’ οὐρανοῦ ἐπὶ πᾶσαν ἀσέβειαν καὶ ἀδικίαν ἀνθρώπων τῶν κατεχόντων τὴν ἀλήθειαν ἐν ἀδικίᾳ
verses.transliteration: gar orgē Theou Apokalyptetai ap’ ouranou epi pasan asebeian kai adikian anthrōpōn tōn katechontōn tēn alētheian en adikia
verses.literal: - [The] wrath of God is being revealed from heaven against all [the] godlessness and wickedness of men who suppress the truth by [their] wickedness

verses.original: διότι τὸ γνωστὸν τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐστιν φανερόν ἐν αὐτοῖς γὰρ ὁ θεὸς ἐφανέρωσεν αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: dioti to gnōston tou Theou estin phaneron en autois gar ho theos ephanerōsen autois
verses.literal: For [what may be] known - [about] God is plain to them because - God has made [it] plain to them

verses.original: γὰρ ἀπὸ κτίσεως κόσμου αὐτοῦ τὰ ἀόρατα τε ἥ αὐτοῦ ἀΐδιος δύναμις καὶ θειότης καθορᾶται νοούμενα τοῖς ποιήμασιν εἰς αὐτοὺς τὸ εἶναι ἀναπολογήτους
verses.transliteration: gar apo ktiseōs kosmou autou ta aorata te hē autou aidios dynamis kai theiotēs kathoratai nooumena tois poiēmasin eis autous to einai anapologētous
verses.literal: For since [the] creation of [the] world [God’s] - invisible qualities - - His eternal power and divine nature have been clearly seen being understood from His workmanship so that [men] - are without excuse

verses.original: Διότι γνόντες τὸν Θεὸν ἐδόξασαν οὐχ ὡς Θεὸν ἢ ηὐχαρίστησαν ἀλλὰ ἐματαιώθησαν ἐν αὐτῶν τοῖς διαλογισμοῖς καὶ ἐσκοτίσθη αὐτῶν ἡ ἀσύνετος καρδία
verses.transliteration: Dioti gnontes ton Theon edoxasan ouch hōs Theon ē ēucharistēsan alla emataiōthēsan en autōn tois dialogismois kai eskotisthē autōn hē asynetos kardia
verses.literal: For although they knew - God they neither glorified [Him] . . . as God [nor] gave thanks [to Him] but they became futile in their - thinking and darkened in their - foolish hearts

verses.original: φάσκοντες εἶναι σοφοὶ ἐμωράνθησαν
verses.transliteration: phaskontes einai sophoi emōranthēsan
verses.literal: Although they claimed to be wise they became fools

verses.original: καὶ ἤλλαξαν τὴν δόξαν τοῦ ἀφθάρτου Θεοῦ ἐν ὁμοιώματι εἰκόνος φθαρτοῦ ἀνθρώπου καὶ πετεινῶν καὶ τετραπόδων καὶ ἑρπετῶν
verses.transliteration: kai ēllaxan tēn doxan tou aphthartou Theou en homoiōmati eikonos phthartou anthrōpou kai peteinōn kai tetrapodōn kai herpetōn
verses.literal: and exchanged the glory of the immortal God for vvv images of mortal man and birds and animals and reptiles

verses.original: Διὸ ὁ Θεὸς παρέδωκεν αὐτοὺς ἐν ταῖς ἐπιθυμίαις τῶν αὐτῶν καρδιῶν εἰς ἀκαθαρσίαν τοῦ ἀτιμάζεσθαι αὐτῶν τὰ σώματα ἐν αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: Dio ho Theos paredōken autous en tais epithymiais tōn autōn kardiōn eis akatharsian tou atimazesthai autōn ta sōmata en autois
verses.literal: Therefore - God gave them over . . . in the desires of their hearts to impurity for the dishonoring of their - bodies with [one another]

verses.original: οἵτινες μετήλλαξαν τὴν ἀλήθειαν τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐν τῷ ψεύδει καὶ ἐσεβάσθησαν καὶ ἐλάτρευσαν τῇ κτίσει παρὰ τὸν Κτίσαντα ὅς ἐστιν εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας εὐλογητὸς ἀμήν
verses.transliteration: hoitines metēllaxan tēn alētheian tou Theou en tō pseudei kai esebasthēsan kai elatreusan tē ktisei para ton Ktisanta hos estin eis tous aiōnas eulogētos amēn
verses.literal: [They] exchanged the truth - of God for - a lie and worshiped and served the creature rather than the Creator who is vvv vvv forever worthy of praise Amen

verses.original: Διὰ τοῦτο ὁ Θεὸς παρέδωκεν αὐτοὺς εἰς ἀτιμίας πάθη τε γὰρ αὐτῶν αἵ θήλειαι μετήλλαξαν τὴν φυσικὴν χρῆσιν εἰς παρὰ φύσιν τὴν
verses.transliteration: Dia touto ho Theos paredōken autous eis atimias pathē te gar autōn hai thēleiai metēllaxan tēn physikēn chrēsin eis para physin tēn
verses.literal: For this reason . . . - God gave them over . . . to dishonorable passions Even - their - women exchanged - natural relations for vvv unnatural [ones]

verses.original: τε ὁμοίως οἱ ἄρσενες καὶ ἀφέντες τὴν φυσικὴν χρῆσιν τῆς θηλείας ἐξεκαύθησαν ἐν αὐτῶν τῇ ὀρέξει εἰς ἀλλήλους ἄρσενες κατεργαζόμενοι τὴν ἀσχημοσύνην ἐν ἄρσεσιν καὶ ἀπολαμβάνοντες ἐν ἑαυτοῖς τὴν ἔδει ἀντιμισθίαν ἣν τῆς αὐτῶν πλάνης
verses.transliteration: te homoiōs hoi arsenes kai aphentes tēn physikēn chrēsin tēs thēleias exekauthēsan en autōn tē orexei eis allēlous arsenes katergazomenoi tēn aschēmosynēn en arsesin kai apolambanontes en heautois tēn edei antimisthian hēn tēs autōn planēs
verses.literal: - Likewise the men - abandoned - natural relations with women [and] burned with - - lust for one another Men committed - indecent [acts] with [other] men and received in themselves the due penalty - for their error

verses.original: Καὶ καθὼς οὐκ ἐδοκίμασαν ἔχειν ἐν ἐπιγνώσει τὸν Θεὸν ὁ Θεὸς παρέδωκεν αὐτοὺς εἰς ἀδόκιμον νοῦν ποιεῖν τὰ μὴ καθήκοντα
verses.transliteration: Kai kathōs ouk edokimasan echein en epignōsei ton Theon ho Theos paredōken autous eis adokimon noun poiein ta mē kathēkonta
verses.literal: Furthermore since vvv they did not see fit to acknowledge . . . . . . - God - [He] gave them up . . . to a depraved mind to do what vvv ought not to be done

verses.original: πεπληρωμένους πάσῃ ἀδικίᾳ πονηρίᾳ πλεονεξίᾳ κακίᾳ μεστοὺς φθόνου φόνου ἔριδος δόλου κακοηθείας ψιθυριστάς
verses.transliteration: peplērōmenous pasē adikia ponēria pleonexia kakia mestous phthonou phonou eridos dolou kakoētheias psithyristas
verses.literal: They have become filled with every kind of wickedness evil greed [and] depravity [They are] full of envy murder strife deceit [and] malice [They are] gossips

verses.original: καταλάλους θεοστυγεῖς ὑβριστάς ὑπερηφάνους ἀλαζόνας ἐφευρετὰς κακῶν ἀπειθεῖς γονεῦσιν
verses.transliteration: katalalous theostygeis hybristas hyperēphanous alazonas epheuretas kakōn apeitheis goneusin
verses.literal: slanderers God-haters insolent arrogant [and] boastful [They] invent [new] forms of evil they disobey [their] parents

verses.original: ἀσυνέτους ἀσυνθέτους ἀστόργους ἀνελεήμονας
verses.transliteration: asynetous asynthetous astorgous aneleēmonas
verses.literal: [They are] senseless faithless heartless merciless

verses.original: οἵτινες ἐπιγνόντες τὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ δικαίωμα ὅτι οἱ πράσσοντες τὰ τοιαῦτα εἰσίν ἄξιοι θανάτου οὐ μόνον ποιοῦσιν αὐτὰ ἀλλὰ καὶ συνευδοκοῦσιν τοῖς πράσσουσιν
verses.transliteration: hoitines epignontes to tou Theou dikaiōma hoti hoi prassontes ta toiauta eisin axioi thanatou ou monon poiousin auta alla kai syneudokousin tois prassousin
verses.literal: [Although they] know - - God’s righteous decree that those who do such things are worthy of death {they} not only continue to do these things but also approve of those who practice [them]
